breakdown.description: Both RAS and LES models are defined in `turbulenceProperties`. An OpenFOAM simulation cannot be both RAS and LES simultaneously; one must be chosen.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The turbulence model uses both RAS (k-epsilon) and LES (Smagorinsky) characteristics' and says to 'Configure turbulenceProperties as specified in the input,' which preserves the original error of defining both RAS and LES simultaneously. The ground truth requires only RAS (k-Epsilon) with the LES block removed entirely.
